title: Roy's Big Discovery
summary: Roy the boy discovers a shiny coin in the garden and learns how to help others with his special find.

pages.text: Roy was a boy who loved to play outside. He would play in the yard every day.
pages.scene: A young boy playing in a sunny garden with flowers and trees

pages.text: One day, Roy heard a sound. "What is that noise?" he said to himself.
pages.scene: Roy looking curious, tilting his head to listen to something in the yard

pages.text: Roy saw something bright in the ground. He pointed at it. "Wow! Look at that shine!"
pages.scene: Roy kneeling down, pointing at something shiny buried in the soil

pages.text: He pulled it out. It was a coin! A golden coin that would not stain.
pages.scene: Roy holding up a shiny gold coin, eyes wide with joy

pages.text: "This is so cool!" Roy said out loud. "I can use this in a neat way!"
pages.scene: Roy jumping up and down with excitement, holding the coin high

pages.text: Roy went to town. The town was loud with noise from all the people and cars.
pages.scene: A busy town square with shops, people, and vehicles

pages.text: Roy saw an old man who was sad. "Why are you sad?" asked Roy.
pages.scene: An elderly man sitting on a bench looking unhappy, Roy approaching him kindly

pages.text: "I lost my coin," said the old man. "Now I can buy no food for lunch."
pages.scene: The old man looking down sadly, gesturing about his empty pocket

pages.text: Roy knew what to do. He put his coin in the man's hand. "This is for you!"
pages.scene: Roy placing the golden coin into the old man's weathered palm

pages.text: The old man's eyes grew wide. "How did you know how I could be helped?"
pages.scene: The old man's face transforming from sad to joyful, hands covering his heart

pages.text: "I found this in the soil," Roy said with a smile. "Now you found joy!"
pages.scene: Roy smiling proudly as the old man hugs him gratefully

pages.text: The man bought food and sat on a bench in the town. He was not sad now.
pages.scene: The old man eating and smiling peacefully in the town square

pages.text: Roy walked home. His heart felt warm and light. He had made a change.
pages.scene: Roy walking home at sunset, feeling proud and happy

pages.text: Roy learned that day: his find could help someone. Kind acts bring joy to all.
pages.scene: Roy in his garden, looking at the ground where he found the coin, smiling
